name: Mappy (Talent Map)
description: Give it a company name and it returns a headcount picture: which functions exist, at what seniority, and in which offices. This is org-chart reconnaissance rather than sourcing, so anyone wanting a shortlist of approachable candidates is asking the wrong tool.

official.title: Mappy by Nick
official.description: Maps who currently works at a named company — a census of the team by function, seniority, and location, not a candidate search. Built for recruiters...
